survey: The object is a spiral topiary shrub in a round raised planter on a garden path. Main parts: (1) The foliage mass is clipped into four stacked tiers that get smaller toward the top, with a small leafy tip. The tiers read as one continuous spiral of clipped leaves, which is a real topiary form. Each tier rests on the one below and leans slightly, as real spiral topiaries do. (2) The base of the shrub sits in a bed of brown soil and fills most of it, with soil visible around the edge. The widest tier overhangs the soil a little, which is normal for a dense shrub, and no trunk shows because the foliage is so dense. (3) The planter is a closed ring of rounded stone blocks of similar size, set on the paving. Its curve is even, it reads as round in perspective, and it holds the soil. (4) The planter sits on the pink flagstone path with contact shadows, so nothing floats. The bench, lamp and hedge in the background belong to the setting and are not part of the object.
